deuce.facts: Official map connects Fremont Street Experience and Downtown with Strip stops including Treasure Island, Caesars/Bellagio, Park MGM, Luxor/Mandalay Bay. deuce.hotelConnection: Four Queens is on Fremont Street. Casino Royale is on the central Strip. El Cortez is east of the Fremont Street Experience; reaching the mapped downtown stops entails a longer walk. No exact walking time or Christmas-date door-to-door bus duration was verified.
deuce.fareStatus: No new live fare quote included; current fare webpage returned403 to web fetch. Existing city-transport allowances should be kept separate from room prices.

transport.parking: Default no-rental route has no hotel-parking cost. Four Queens parking5/day applies if a car is used; Casino Royale free parking and El Cortez parking included in its amenity fee. Do not add parking to the hotel comparison when no car is rented.
transport.luggage: The3-day MaxTour webpage says large luggage/suitcases are not carried. Hotel storage between checkout21 and return23 must be confirmed; neither retaining two empty Vegas room nights nor assuming free luggage storage has been added.
